case: Only if you truly believe Bijan's late-season history will pull him out of this slump should you send this, and I don't think you should. He's been the RB27 lately, and the Falcons offense sits near the bottom of the league, so he isn't a safe start right now. Gibbs is the RB1 on a strong Lions offense, and he's worth more than Bijan on the chart this week. The upside is real, since Bijan has finished strong in past second halves, but you're in a playoff spot and this hands points to a team on the bubble. Keep Gibbs and let the other manager find his upgrade somewhere else.
